paragraphs: An E. coli outbreak linked to frozen blueberries is now over, the CDC reported [1]. The outbreak affected 17 people across 2 states, resulting in 6 hospitalizations and no deaths [1].

Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. is recalling Starfish Seafood Trio—Cold Smoked Salmon, Halibut, and Trout (8 oz packages) because the product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes [4]. Two broccoli sprouting seed companies have recalled their products due to possible Salmonella contamination: Gardeners Basics is recalling one-pound bags of Waltham 29 Broccoli Sprouting Seeds [5], and Eden Brothers LLC is recalling Calabrese Broccoli Seeds in 1-ounce and 1-pound packet sizes [6]. Oliva LLC is recalling approximately 250 units of Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus because they may contain undeclared sesame, which poses a risk to people with sesame allergies or sensitivities [3].

The USDA has issued a public health alert for 140-gram cans of Grace Ready to Eat Chicken Vienna Sausages that were illegally imported from Jamaica; the products were distributed in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, and Texas [2].
